Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent will not be the first AI czar to lead the so-called AI Force, President Donald Trump confirmed on Friday.

The president appeared to be addressing a Semafor report that listed Bessent as a top contender for the new role.

Actual Article Body:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

President Trump has reportedly rejected a seven-day cease-fire proposed by Iran and expects to resume bombing the country after the midterm elections.

As part of the proposed cease-fire, Tehran pledged to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and resume negotiations on dismantling its nuclear program in exchange for the US ending its blockade of Iranian ports.

However, Trump is “skeptical” Iran will agree to his demands and has told aides it is “likely” the US military restarts airstrikes after the November contests, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday, citing US officials.

It’s unclear what level of strikes Trump is planning on launching.

By

Emily Feng

,

Deepa Shivaram

,

Rob Schmitz

President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping (left) speak via an interpreter as they depart following a tour of the National Archives Museum in Washington, D.C., on Sept. 25.
                
                    
                    Win McNamee/Getty Images
                    
                
                hide caption

President Trump rolled out the red carpet for Xi Jinping this week for the first state visit that the Chinese leader has made since 2015.

The visit comes at an important time for both men. For Trump, the state visit comes about six weeks before the midterm elections. Xi has an important calendar ahead as well, with a key Communist Party meeting scheduled for next month that should set up a widely expected announcement next fall that Xi will rule for another five-year term.

But there were a few commitments that came out of the meetings in Washington this week and more emphasis put on pageantry.

The U.S. says the two countries will extend by two
